note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Every guide is written for this entry, in its own words, and names its sources. Methods marked unconfirmed had no confirmed method at launch on 19 Nov 2026.

exo.label: Exophase & PSNProfiles trophy list, via Planet GTA 6

kg.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the stranger strands and the clean-up trophies. Launch guides put the whole run at roughly 200 hours, so treat this as a long project, not a weekend.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of the game, so this pops in the opening hour. Just follow the on-screen prompts through the mission; nothing here can be missed, and it unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapters end on their own as you complete their missions, so keep playing the story in order. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one interaction the launch guides flag as possibly missable, so handle it here and make a manual save.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progress only — no side work is needed. Most of the open-world list opens up once Jason and Lucia are both playable in this chapter, so use it to start scanning vehicles with WAiNK and trying the activities the map offers.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. The robbery trophies start opening up in this part of the story, so take the robbery introductions as they come.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last story chapter before the finale — keep the missions coming and it pops at the chapter's end. The big bank vaults unlock in this chapter, so the robbery grind properly starts here.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is one of the two gold trophies, and it closes the story. Keep a manual save before the finale — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back to the ending if you want to revisit it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears as part of the story — play the missions in order and it will come up. Mission trophies like this one cannot be missed; finish the mission and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist, so it unlocks by playing the campaign — no preparation needed, just reach it in the mission order and finish it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another mission trophy that comes with the story — play through the campaign and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Story-only: reach it in the mission order, finish it, and the trophy unlocks. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play the story in order; the mission arrives on its own and the trophy follows when you finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story-mission trophies — it comes with the campaign, so just keep playing the missions in order until it appears.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist it shows. The big blocks are the story, 100 optional tasks, the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), the collectibles and the activities (42 shooting-range gold medals, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges). Note the trophy numbers are lower than the 100% numbers in places — 250 stunts earns Cunning Stunts but 100% wants 300 — so keep going past the trophy thresholds. This is the second gold trophy and the hardest one in the list.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all feed the stunt total. They stack up naturally across the story and free roam, so don't grind them early; for 100% completion you need 300 stunts, so keep going after this one pops and count every jump on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. The game counts a type the first time you start it, so visit the activities the map offers — shooting ranges, races, drone trials, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf, basketball and fishing are the ones this list names — and one attempt at each ticks it off. You don't need to win or finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are found across Leonida; gold needs a clean, fast run, so learn each range's targets and timing before chasing the medal. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so there is no shortcut past this one — it is one of the longest grinds in the list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, and winning once per location is enough. The 42 drone time trials for 100% completion are a separate, longer grind at the same spots, so learn the courses here and the time trials get easier later.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races unlock across Leonida as you explore, so keep entering new ones as they appear. 100% completion wants 30 of the 40 races won, so keep racing past 20 and the extra wins count toward both.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges run through the fishing activity, and Cal is the rival angler — win one head-to-head challenge against him and the trophy pops. If you lose, just challenge him again; the trophy only cares about the win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end — finishing is what counts, not the score. Playing all four video games is part of the 100% completion checklist, so try the other cabinets while you are there.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side-character questline — keep taking his missions whenever they appear on the map and the final one pops this trophy. Side-character missions stay available in free roam after the story, so you can finish this in the clean-up phase.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other character trophies: follow Kenton's mission strand to its end. His strand also ties into the treasure sets on the 100% checklist, so working it early helps two goals at once.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Take Billy's missions as they appear and finish the strand — the trophy is the reward for the last one. Like the other character finals, it can be done in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore — take every one you meet and follow each strand to its end. There are more strands than the 8 needed, so you can skip the ones you don't like and still finish the trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its final mission — the trophy pops when that mission ends. Finish it in the clean-up phase if it is still open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Take Tyrone's missions whenever they appear and finish the strand — the last mission is the trophy. It stays available in free roam, so it fits the post-story clean-up.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. THE possibly missable trophy: after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation — guides report this spot can disappear after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends and make a manual save. The other spots are marked meditation locations you can visit with either character, and each one counts toward the 18. 100% completion needs only 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all of them.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you at one specific rare animal — follow his target deck, track the animal to its area, and take the shot when it appears. His full target deck (15 objectives) is part of the 100% completion checklist, so the hunting strand pays off twice.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. 100% completion wants 15 of the 18 sets, so the trophy's 3 sets are just the start — keep collecting after it pops.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan something new — landmarks and vehicles both count. Scan as you travel instead of saving it for the end, and the 100 comes naturally; 100% completion also wants exactly 100 scans, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives, tracked in the Progress menu — many complete themselves as you play the story and explore. 100% completion wants 70 of the 80, so keep going after 50 and skip the 10 hardest ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Get the heat up to four stars with Lucia or Jason beside you — cause trouble in a busy area until the fourth star appears — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Losing the cops is the trophy, not the crime.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner present, keeping at least one star the whole time — don't let the heat drop between robberies, and don't let it spike so high you get caught. Pick three shops close together and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time the game registers it — driving one, or scanning it with the WAiNK app, both add to the total. 100% completion wants 200 base models out of 277, so keep discovering after this pops; scanning every new model you pass is the cheapest way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when five enemies are grouped — a gang hideout or a shootout with cover works — and drop all five before the focus ends. Pick a fight where the enemies come to you, so they stay in range.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. The reported method is to steal a departing passenger aircraft from the airport and get it airborne — wait for a plane that is about to leave, take it, and take off. Treat that as reported rather than confirmed: it is the launch guides' reading of the description, and no guide has shown the exact trigger yet.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos turn up at military sites and in high-heat chases — take one, then use its cannon in a fight. You need the tank and the combat, so don't just park it: fire the cannon at something that shoots back.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Plan the entry, take the goods and leave before anyone spots you; if the alarm goes off, leave and try again rather than fighting through it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big bank jobs — 100% completion wants all 8, and they unlock properly in Chapter 4, when the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens them up. Rob five and get clean away; the escape counts, so plan the getaway before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — stop one, take the cash and break away before the police close in. A fast car waiting nearby makes the escape much easier than stealing one on the spot.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail into every corner until the map is uncovered — the game tracks 52 areas. Work the edges of the map systematically, area by area, and the last one pops the trophy. It pairs well with the WAiNK scanning for You WAiNKer!, so do both on the same trips.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs illegal operations; hit at least one per gang. The map and your contacts point you at them once robberies open up — keep a list of which gangs you have hit so you don't repeat one and miss another.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed method at launch — the description reads like a quiet moment at a beach bar, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger, bar or time of day yet. Don't chase an unconfirmed step; check back once players have verified it. (Unconfirmed at launch, 19 Nov 2026.)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed method at launch — the name points at driving a car through a showroom's front, but no guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger. (Unconfirmed at launch, 19 Nov 2026.)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The launch guides report the trigger is stealing the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escaping — treat that as reported, not confirmed, until more players have verified it. If the valuables aren't there on your visit, come back later in the story.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The launch guides report this one is about maxing the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — train Strength with each character until it peaks. Reported, not yet widely confirmed; train both characters steadily and it should land on its own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The launch guides count 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile — the small choices and crimes you commit across the whole game add up. It is a long passive grind, not a single mission: just play, make choices, and check the counter in the Progress menu now and then.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method at launch — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something, but no guide has confirmed what. Don't guess at it; wait for a verified method. (Unconfirmed at launch, 19 Nov 2026.)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed method at launch — the name and description suggest a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida, but nothing is confirmed. The most honest advice is to explore widely and watch for odd events; a verified method will replace this note once players find it. (Unconfirmed at launch, 19 Nov 2026.)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The name describes knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle; the precise method is still being confirmed. Try a slow drive-by with a melee weapon against a pedestrian target in a quiet area — and treat that as a reading of the name, not a verified step. (Unconfirmed at launch, 19 Nov 2026.)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — fence them through your contacts and the total climbs. The same $250,000 is also part of the 100% completion checklist, so the money counts twice: once here, once toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just spend — weapons, clothes, cars, food: every shop purchase counts toward the total. It adds up across the whole playthrough, and the big purchases late in the game (cars, garages) finish it off.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy each one when it appears. You need the money for them, so this usually lands late, after the big robberies — keep an eye on property listings in free roam and buy as soon as you can afford each one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — 10 registrations pops it. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and top the number up with cars you find on the street.
